title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
description: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.
text:
Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. Moments later, the man who had just lost Brazil's presidential election, Flávio Bolsonaro, stepped out onto the tarmac. CARRIE KAHN, Hi.

SUMMERS: So, Carrie, I want to make sure I understand this correctly. Bolsonaro lost Sunday's election, and by Wednesday, he was in the U.S.? By Tuesday, yesterday, rumors were flying that Bolsonaro had fled Brazil, and today he arrived in Miami and then later put out a statement first declaring himself as, quote, "the true elected president of Brazil." Then a bit later, he posted a new statement downgrading himself to the true elected leader of Brazil.
